title: Uncovering Systematic Blind Spots in Graph Database Testing through Integration and Process-Level Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.07754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph databases are becoming foundational infrastructure for connected data, and a growing body of automated testing techniques has uncovered many bugs across mature graph database systems. Each technique checks a different aspect of correctness and exposes a different class of defect. Combining them is the natural next step, but each technique is judged by the real bugs it finds, not by useless reports or tests that can never fail, and that is what decides whether a developer can afford to fix the problems. To identify the remaining gaps, we integrated test capabilities from 8 testing methods and conducted an empirical study of their behavior, during which we found two blind spots. First, 12 hours of testing produce thousands of bug reports, far more than the number of genuine defects a mature database is likely to contain. translated_title: 通过集成与过程级分析揭示图数据库测试中的系统性盲点
translated_abstract: 图数据库正在成为互联数据的基础设施，越来越多的自动化测试技术已在成熟的图数据库系统中发现了大量缺陷。每种技术检查正确性的不同方面，并暴露不同类型的缺陷。将它们结合起来是自然的下一步，但每种技术的评判标准在于它发现的真实缺陷数量，而非无用的报告或永远不会失败的测试，这决定了开发者能否负担起修复这些问题的成本。为了找出仍然存在的差距，我们集成了8种测试方法的测试能力，并对它们的行为进行了实证研究，在此过程中我们发现了两个盲点。第一，12小时的测试会产生数千份缺陷报告，远超一个成熟数据库可能包含的真实缺陷数量，其中大多数报告是由方言或模式匹配差异引起的误报，而其余报告中许多……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过集成8种图数据库自动化测试方法并进行过程级实证分析，揭示了图数据库测试中存在大量由方言和模式匹配差异导致的误报缺陷报告等系统性盲点。
en_tdlr: By integrating 8 graph database testing techniques and conducting a process-level empirical analysis, this study uncovers systematic blind spots in graph database testing, such as thousands of false-positive bug reports caused by dialect and pattern-matching differences.
